# A non-regular -o target is streamed into directly: rename cannot
# replace a device and it holds no previous image to protect — and a
# failed build neither warns about nor attempts its removal. The
# broken variant waits outside the solution directory so only the
# current spelling is ever loaded.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

cd sol
exec go mod edit -replace=github.com/modern-engineering/prototype=$SDLREPO
cp $SDLREPO/go.sum go.sum
sdl build -o $devnull
! stderr .

cp $WORK/variants/broken-link.sdl sol.sdl
status 1 sdl build -o $devnull
! stderr 'removing'

-- sol/go.mod --
module example.test/sol

go 1.25.0

require github.com/modern-engineering/prototype v0.0.0
-- sol/sol.sdl --
solution device

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Ping as Ping1
-- variants/broken-link.sdl --
solution device

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Gone as G
